## ResolveArgv0Options.transparentWrappers property

The transparent-wrapper table to follow. Defaults to [DEFAULT\_TRANSPARENT\_WRAPPERS](./sh-analysis.default_transparent_wrappers.md)<!-- -->. Pass a replacement array to drop a default entry entirely (that wrapper is then treated as an ordinary, non-transparent effective command), or add project-specific entries (e.g. a `with-retry` wrapper) — the table is plain data, not baked-in policy.

Only omission or `undefined` selects defaults; an empty array deliberately disables wrapper following. A supplied table must be an array with a valid non-null object at every position, and flag arrays must contain strings in every slot. Non-array containers (including `null`<!-- -->), missing table/field elements and malformed entries throw [ShAnalyzeInvalidWrapperSpecError](./sh-analysis.shanalyzeinvalidwrapperspecerror.md) before command matching rather than becoming defaults or native failures.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly transparentWrappers?: readonly WrapperSpec[];
```
